claim: v6 adds trusted arbitrary planar-profile add/cut, rejects non-constant sections, preserves the controlled real-RGB safety decisions, and makes the final programs deterministic on two independent runs

architecture_change.learned_policy_role: propose a restricted CADENA construction root
architecture_change.measured_feature_role: fit bounded axial or arbitrary-polyline constant-section additions and subtractions from signed target-surface residuals after each valid root or rewrite

planar_profile.primitive: arbitrary closed 2D polyline, not a part-class dictionary
planar_profile.add_attachment: measured profile is extended 2% into the nearest current-solid face before exact union
planar_profile.cut_extent: a measured near-face interval is extended through that face before exact subtraction

decoder_determinism.reason: one quantization-boundary VTK pixel changed a sampled policy branch; a full-resolution morphological opening removes isolated bright spurs without the quality loss caused by 2x downsampling

architecture_change.construction_graph: learned proposal -> exact profile rewrite -> zero to two trusted measured operations, with evidence and kernel validation on every accepted node

planar_grammar_benchmark.purpose: capability test from target-surface points plus a known root B-Rep; not an end-to-end photo benchmark

object_2.selected_branch: revolve-proxy root -> profile rewrite -> conservative measured axial-revolved-cut
object_2.visual_audit: the measured cavity remains present; the macro envelope improves by IoU, while the surface-distance trade-off and missing fine external detail remain explicit
object_2.product_reason: the measured cavity passes the kernel and 32-source-view topology gates; this remains a provisional controlled-case acceptance

object_4.selected_branch: measured-target root -> profile rewrite -> conservative measured axial-revolved-add
object_4.visual_audit: the macro envelope remains improved, but unexplained image edges keep the candidate at ABSTAIN
object_4.product_reason: macro geometry remains strong, but edge precision stays below the frozen safety threshold, so no STEP is released as accepted

reproducibility.product_effect: none: final candidate program, STEP, decision and post-hoc metrics are identical

evaluator.alignment: independent bbox centering and largest-extent normalization; no ICP or per-axis scaling
evaluator.reference_access: post-hoc after program and ACCEPT/ABSTAIN decision were frozen

claim_boundary.demonstrated: a trusted grammar can recover axis-aligned arbitrary constant-section L/T/U/hex-like features from measured 3D residuals and retain prior axial real-RGB behavior
claim_boundary.not_demonstrated: universal image-to-CAD, free-form surfaces, arbitrary feature orientation, assemblies, fillets, chamfers, patterns, or real-photo planar-feature accuracy
claim_boundary.da3_role: optional depth prior upstream; not used in the two calibrated dense real controls
